name: ohhnico-github-io
description: Personal site for Nicolo Rengifo. The page is the spec sheet of its own making: white, one petrol accent, controls with travel. Tailwind compiles src/input.css to style.css and esbuild bundles src/main.js to app.js; both outputs are committed and are the only stylesheet and the only script the page loads, so the published page makes no third-party requests.

scripts.build: npm run build:css && npm run build:js
scripts.dev: npm run build:css -- --watch & npm run build:js -- --watch --sourcemap
